facts.fact: The Liberian Investigator reports the Swedish-funded SLSL project manager said the project introduced a Digital Land Administration System at the Liberia Land Authority, alongside the online Customary Land Information Management Tool, at its closing seminar in June 2026.

The Liberian Investigator reports the SLSL project digitised the historic Monrovia Atlas, scanned 232 archived maps and developed the online CLIMT for customary land administration, as reported at its June 2026 closing seminar.

LBR.note: Starlink is installed for government county land offices only; no licensing or sale is stated.
